title: Frequently asked questions
description: Answers to common questions about Elite Consolidated Business Nig Ltd and its businesses.

items.q: What is Elite Consolidated Business Nig Ltd?
items.a: Elite Consolidated Business Nig Ltd is the parent company of Starling Bottle and Pure Water Factory, Royal Retreat Bakery, and Elite Royal Suite and Hotel.

items.q: Which businesses operate under Elite Consolidated?
items.a: Our business portfolio includes Starling Bottle and Pure Water Factory, Royal Retreat Bakery, and Elite Royal Suite and Hotel.

items.q: Where is Starling Bottle and Pure Water Factory located?
items.a: Starling Bottle and Pure Water Factory has two locations: Abijo and Bogije.

items.q: How can I enquire about your businesses?
items.a: Please use the contact information provided on our website to enquire about a business, its products, or its services.

items.q: How can I make a hotel reservation or enquire about bakery and water products?
items.a: Please contact the relevant business for information about availability, products, ordering options, or accommodation reservations.
